annotations.title: Why vvas.
annotations.text: So wicked, couetous, and ſacrilegious perſons reprehend good men for beſtowing their goods vpon Church ornaments &c. <mn>◦</mn> vnder pretence of better beſtowing them on the poore. ſuch prouide for the poore as Iudas did.

annotations.title: A theefe.
annotations.text: Iudas did not then firſt periſh when he ſould our Lord, for he was a theefe before: and being loſt he yet folowed Chriſt, not in hart, but in body onely. Which our Maiſter tolerated, ◦ to giue vs a leſſon to tolerate the il, rather then deuide the body. Aug. tract. 50 in Io.
